title: Long Beach Marina
specs: Family-friendly, full-service marina with pool and beachside areas
Newly renovated indoor and outdoor restaurant with tropical ambiance
Outdoor seating with fire pits, couch seating, and seasonal decor
blurb: Long Beach Marina is a full-service marina located on Chesapeake Bay near Baltimore. It offers slip rentals, a pool, beachside family areas, and a newly renovated indoor and outdoor restaurant with tropical ambiance. Guests can enjoy waterfront dining, fire pits, and seasonal outdoor seating from spring through Halloween.
extraNote: Outdoor seating available from spring through Halloween, weather permitting
